serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: She’s been a little grumpy since I told her about my… financial predicament. We are outside so I need to be careful about my wording. I wouldn’t want anyone to eavesdrop and get any stupid ideas. Bot: I’m sure she will forget about it soon. She doesn’t seem like a person who would keep a grudge about something like this. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Angry You: You never know. People are complicated creatures. We don’t know much about Annalie after all. Bot: I can’t believe you would lose your trust in Annalie that easily! I’m disappointed! #bot.Expression.clear You: Calm down. It’s not like I lost all hope in her or something like that. I had many people turn their backs on me over things even smaller than that, so I just naturally got mentally prepared for the worst… Bot: I didn’t know that…{{wi}} Sorry. #bot.Expression.Angry Bot: But still! I trust Annalie! #bot.Expression.clear You: Suit yourself. I want to trust her too, but I just can’t help being on guard a little. I’m getting nervous. What if we don’t mend this during this meetup? All I can do is hope for the best and try to enjoy myself.
